title: Claims Handler
description:
Claims Technician

Location: Chelmsford or Glasgow

Working Pattern: Hybrid - minimum 3 days per week in the office

The Opportunity

We are currently recruiting for a Claims Technician to join a busy Real Estate team.

This is an entry-level opportunity, providing administrative and technical support to the Real Estate claims team. You will work closely with Account Handlers, Claims Adjusters and internal teams, helping to ensure claims are administered accurately and efficiently.

This would suit an organised and proactive individual looking to build a career within the insurance industry. Previous insurance or claims experience is not essential, as full training and support will be provided.

Key Responsibilities
- Providing administrative support across Real Estate accounts
- Accurately inputting and maintaining data and ensuring high standards of data quality
- Managing diaries and allocating correspondence and post to the appropriate files
- Responding to internal and external queries professionally
- Supporting Account Handlers and Claims Adjusters with day-to-day tasks
- Assisting with invoicing, billing and financial administration
- Preparing, checking and issuing management information reports
- Assisting with the onboarding of new clients
- Chasing outstanding documentation and information
- Assisting with the closure of files
- Attending meetings and taking minutes where required
- Supporting client review meetings and renewal documentation
- Assisting with projects and other ad-hoc tasks as required

About You

We are looking for someone who is:
- Highly organised with excellent attention to detail
- Confident communicating with colleagues, clients and external contacts
- Comfortable managing multiple tasks and prioritising workloads
- Professional and customer-focused
- Proactive and willing to learn
- Confident using Microsoft Office, particularly Word, Excel, Outlook and PowerPoint
- Able to build strong relationships both internally and externally

Advanced Excel skills would be advantageous but are not essential.

What's on Offer
- Competitive salary and performance-related incentives
- Hybrid working
- Full training and ongoing technical development
- Career progression opportunities within the insurance industry
- Exposure to a global client base and insurance professionals
- A collaborative and supportive working environment

title: Property Inspections Team Coordinator
description:
Property Inspections Team Coordinator

Location: Chelmsford / Hybrid
Salary: 25,000 - 28,000 + bonuses
Full-time Permanent No weekends

We are currently recruiting for a Property Inspections Team Coordinator to join the busy property management and inspections team of a highly successful and established independent estate agency.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced residential lettings professional looking to develop their career within property administration, inspections and tenancy management.

Following successful completion of the initial probationary period, the role will become hybrid, offering a combination of home and office-based working.

The Role

As Property Inspections Team Coordinator, you will provide essential administrative and coordination support to the property inspections team, helping to ensure appointments, inventories, compliance requirements and tenancy deposits are managed efficiently.

You will work closely with Property Inspection Consultants, inventory clerks, branches, landlords, tenants and internal teams, playing a key role in keeping the department organised and ensuring appointments and processes run smoothly.

Key Responsibilities
- Coordinate and book property inspection visits and check-out appointments.
- Send reminder communications to tenants moving out.
- Update property management systems with meter readings, appliances and smoke/CO alarm information from inventories.
- Rearrange property visits and manage changes to appointments.
- Monitor group emails and handle calls when Property Inspection Consultants are unavailable.
- Manage Property Inspection Consultants' diaries and agency bookings.
- Arrange deposit releases and submit relevant documentation to accounts.
- Assist with deposit negotiations between landlords and tenants.
- Process relevant paperwork for independent deposit adjudication where required.
- Manage information across third-party CRM systems relating to inventories and condition reports.
- Monitor incoming inventories and ensure compliance requirements are met.
- Liaise with progressors and branches where there are issues affecting compliance or property readiness.
- Coordinate last-minute inventory appointments between inventory clerks and branches.
- Download and distribute completed inventories to landlords.
- Support the Team Leader with day-to-day departmental tasks.
- Maintain accurate records and ensure all processes are completed efficiently and within required timescales.

About You

We are looking for an organised and proactive property professional with previous experience within residential lettings.

You should have:
- Current or previous experience within residential lettings - essential.
- Excellent organisational and prioritisation skills.
- A proactive "can-do" attitude.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- A personable, outgoing and enthusiastic approach.
- Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
- The ability to work independently while also contributing effectively as part of a team.
- Good IT skills and confidence using Microsoft Office.
- The ability to learn and adapt quickly to new technology and property management systems.
- A professional and customer-focused approach.

Salary & Benefits

25,000 - 28,000 basic salary, depending on skills and industry experience, plus bonuses.

The role also offers:
- Hybrid working following probation.
- Birthday day off.
- Company pension.
- Training and development opportunities.
- Regular company events.
- Financial referral programme.
- Performance-related bonuses.
- Retail vouchers and rewards for outstanding performers.
- Additional benefits linked to length of service.
- Excellent opportunities for career progression.

Working Hours

Monday - Friday: 8:30am - 5:30pm

No weekend working.

Following successful completion of the probationary period, the role will operate on a hybrid basis:

3 days at Head Office in Chelmsford + 2 days working from home.

Apply Now

If you have experience within residential lettings, property management, tenancy administration or estate agency and are looking for a varied coordination role with an established and supportive property business, we would love to hear from you.

Apply today for a confidential conversation about this opportunity.

title: Administrator - Chelmsford
description: Job summary Job title: Administrator Contract: Bank Start: September 2026 until December 2026 Working Hours: Monday to Friday between 8:00am - 5:00pm. (7.5 hour shift per day) BENEFITS: Pension - 5% employer contribution based on qualified earnings. VIVUP - Supermarket & High Street Discounts & Employee Assistant Programme. Blue Light Card - Supermarket & High Street Discounts. Employee referral scheme. 28 days annual leave including Bank Holidays (pro-rata). Main duties of the job The post holder will be responsible for promoting, delivering, and facilitating various programmes directed by management as part of the School-Aged Immunisation Service assisting nurses in the schools or office. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: Assist in the planning, delivery and evaluation of health promotion/education and public health school age immunisation programmes. Attend community-based vaccination sessions in both schools and local based settings. Work with the nursing team to ensure productive and safe sessions. Promote and facilitate collaborative working between the team, schools and other educational institutions and families, in the delivery of the immunisation programmes. Focus on ensuring all consent forms have been returned, guaranteeing new ideas go towards achieving local area targets. Ensure the process for storing, transporting, collecting and delivering vaccinations to site are adhered to. Assist in identifying home schooled children and those in Pupil Referral Units. Maintain databases to ensure records are kept up to date and that documents are prepared for school visits. Ensure online consent systems have been triaged and completed ahead of a vaccination session. Adhere to the Standard Operating Procedure for School Immunisation (SOPs). First point of contact for all administrative tasks. Have clear communication via face to face, by phone and email with children, parents and school staff. Responsible for maintaining the cold chain, ordering, and arranging transport of vaccinations to site. Actively and constructively contribute to team meetings. Undertake other duties commensurate with the level of this position. Comply with Company policies & procedures.
